description: Utility functions for device management, network configuration, and session handling in a web-based device management system.

methods.name: php_getstr
methods.description: Wraps getStr to conditionally return empty string based on PSM mode and session variables.

methods.name: php_getinstanceids
methods.description: Wraps getInstanceIds to conditionally return empty string based on PSM mode and session variables.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves key-value pairs from device management extension API, mapping parameter names to values.

methods.name: encrypt_map
methods.description: Maps network security modes and methods to descriptive strings.

methods.name: getLeafName
methods.description: Extracts the leaf parameter name from a device management path.

methods.name: getObjIdInPath
methods.description: Extracts object ID (e.g., {i}) from a device management path.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves specific parameter values for device objects, optionally including object IDs.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Generates a webpage notification if the device is operating in battery mode (PSM).

methods.name: php_str_and
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND operation on two hex strings.

methods.name: array_trim
methods.description: Removes leading/trailing whitespace and empty elements from an array.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Reads default values from an XML file based on specified parameter names.

methods.name: div_sub
methods.description: Performs division by repeated subtraction, returning quotient and remainder.

methods.name: hm_to_sec
methods.description: Converts hours:minutes string to total seconds.

methods.name: sec_to_hm
methods.description: Converts seconds to hours:minutes string.

methods.name: shift_blockedDays
methods.description: Shifts blocked days forward or backward by one day.

methods.name: group_2D_array
methods.description: Groups a 2D array by specified fields.

methods.name: local_to_UTC_Time
methods.description: Converts local time to UTC, adjusting for day changes.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_Time
methods.description: Converts UTC time to local time, adjusting for day changes.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_date
methods.description: Converts UTC datetime string to local date string.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_date_logs
methods.description: Converts UTC datetime string to local log date string.

methods.name: time_in_min
methods.description: Converts HH:MM time string to total minutes.

methods.name: cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting by StartTime.

methods.name: merge_days
methods.description: Merges overlapping or consecutive time ranges.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Converts device schedule data from UTC to local time, grouping by specified fields.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_set
methods.description: Converts local schedule data to UTC, adjusting for day changes.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Checks for conflicts between two time/date ranges.

methods.name: resolve_IPV6_global_address
methods.description: Resolves and returns a global IPv6 address from given inputs.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines WAN type: DOCSIS, EPON, or DSL based on device info.
